long_biography.plain_text:
Publity became Thomas Olek’s principal real-estate platform after he acquired a majority interest and took executive control in 2003. Under his leadership, the company shifted into German commercial property, combining asset management, acquisitions and data-led analysis of office markets. His earlier work included advising Sächsische Landesbank, experience that connected distressed-credit analysis with later property investing.

Olek left publity’s management board after nearly two decades and later chaired its supervisory board. He also created an investment company from his holding vehicle, building an investment vehicle for real estate, technology and consulting businesses. After leaving Neon’s executive board in 2024, he remained an influential shareholder and informal adviser while continuing to invest through controlled companies.
